name: Wonder Realms
description: Worlds beyond the everyday. Tiny Worlds: shrink to insect size (and shrink mobs with a Shrink Ray), carve blocks pixel by pixel, trade with the Pixel Miners, ride rhino beetles up walls, fly dragonflies, leap on grasshoppers and catch fireflies. Dragons: win eggs from the dragons of the sky islands, raise them, armor them, pack their saddlebags, saddle up and fly, breathing fire, frost, lightning, spores, water, crystal, shadow, grit that tunnels through stone, sticky honey, rainbows or wind, ride an Air dragon nobody else can see, unleash their powers, wear dragonscale armor, glide on Dragon Wings, wield the Elder Blade, and even hatch the End's Dragon Egg. Sky Islands & Airships: twelve kinds of floating island with dragon roosts, ruins, sky villages, pillager sky outposts and Sky Citadels, where the Elder Dragon waits, sky whales to ride, the Storm Leviathan to face, and airships with cannons to build, paint or capture.
